SELECT m.*, u.username FROM music m LEFT JOIN `user` u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO music (title, artist, description, file_path, file_size, like_count, comment_count, download_count, user_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{artist}, #{description}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{downloadCount}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE music SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE music SET comment_count = comment_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE music SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u.username FROM like_record lr JOIN music m ON lr.music_id = m.id JOIN `user` u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE lr.create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY lr.music_id ORDER BY COUNT(lr.id) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT m.*, u.username FROM download_record dr JOIN music m ON dr.music_id = m.id JOIN `user` u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE dr.create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY dr.music_id ORDER BY COUNT(dr.id) DESC LIMIT 10
